pages.text: Load a $(item)cannon$() by pressing $(k:use) with ammunition in hand. Press $(k:use) again to man it: the view moves behind the gun and follows your aim. $(k:attack) fires; $(k:sneak) steps away.

Lead your shot: ships move, and cannonballs drop over distance. A hit below the waterline does the most harm.$(br2)Man an empty cannon and press $(k:use) with nothing in hand to climb into the barrel, then fire to launch yourself across the sea.
